## Work no door serves

The pipeline's own work (docs/design/blueprint.md, part 8): no Rpc group holds it, so nothing serves it at run
time. Its spans and logs judge it once it is instrumented (roadmap item 4.7). Its budget is a target, never a gate.

### `starting-point.make`

Make a starting point in a world by taking its typed steps, each an operation through the endpoint, in order.

- Payload: `world`, `point`.
- Spans: `starting-point.make.wait` (wait).
- Logs: `starting-point.make.step_failed` (world, point, step).
- Budget: 90,000 ms, a target, provisional. Basis: run.prepare's 2 minutes hold the starting points; making `founded` took 6 minutes before the speed changes.
